text: When a transposed FIR on xc7s50 is DSP-timing-limited (critical path in DSP48E1 at 495 MHz) but uses 45 DSPs, avoid switching to symmetric fold=2 with in_pipe_out DSP registers and acc_width=38, as it reduces DSPs to 16 but moves the critical path to a 4-cell fabric carry chain (out_data_reg), collapsing fmax to 163 MHz (-332.5 MHz) because the symmetric accumulation forces a wide post-adder into fabric.

When a symmetric fold=2 FIR on xc7s50 is over an 8-DSP budget because acc_in_dsp=true spends 16 DSP48E1s, set acc_in_dsp=false to force one DSP48E1 per multiplier (8 DSPs) and move accumulation into fabric CARRY4, accepting a ~13 MHz Fmax loss (163.05 to 150.04 MHz) and +618 LUTs as the fabric carry-chain accumulator becomes critical.

When a symmetric folded FIR on XC7S50 is timing-limited by a fabric carry-chain partial-sum combine, increase the fold from 2 to 4 and enable acc_in_dsp to combine 4 partials in the DSP cascade, raising Fmax from 150.04 to 236.57 MHz (+86.5) and cutting LUTs from 1185 to 360 at 0.25 samples/cycle while holding 8 DSPs.

When a symmetric folded FIR on XC7S50 at fold=4 misses 250 MHz (236.6 MHz) with a route-dominated tap-operand mux/partial-sum critical path, doubling fold to 8 to halve the mux to 2:1 and cut DSPs 8→4 reduced LUTs by 95 but worsened Fmax to 225.5 MHz (-11 MHz) and path delay 3.87→4.12 ns, so do not raise fold to shrink mux depth when routing/combine dominates.

When an xc7s50 symmetric folded FIR is routing-limited by the tap-operand mux at 225.53 MHz, do not halve the fold from 8 to 4 and drop the DSP M pipeline (in_pipe_out→in_out), because it adds 4 DSP48E1s and 60 LUTs and drops Fmax to 152.07 MHz by worsening the same LUT6-to-LUT2 mux/coefficient routing congestion.

When a folded symmetric FIR on XC7S50 misses timing through a routing-heavy tap-operand mux and x[k]+x[N-1-k] pre-adder into the DSP input at fold=4, go non-symmetric fold=8 with acc_width 38->37 and in_out->in_pipe_out DSP registers to remove the pre-adder from that path while keeping 8 DSPs, raising Fmax 152.07->259.07 MHz (+107 MHz) with LUT 325->324.
